status_meaning: Mechanical descriptive decomposition completed; not a capability classification

counting_notes.scientific_units: 20 designed semantic cases; four correlated renderings each; no inferential statistics
counting_notes.authoritative_credits: Copy all original rendering, semantic and matched-pair credits from scores.json. Never call score_benchmark or score_rendering. No upgrade/downgrade.
counting_notes.selected_classification: Original recognized selected enum or null from scores.json; null is a wrong selected class for classification-layer rules. Healthy non-current errors are not assigned a new unauthorized code.
counting_notes.invalid_or_missing_structure: Strict parse failure/non-object gives absent structured fields; missing witness/component values mismatch for gold D. Missing/non-list evidence_ids gives empty returned evidence set; keep only string elements in lists. All original credit fields remain unchanged.
counting_notes.component_exact: Use original exact-list equality, not sorting/deduplication. Frozen gold current component list is singleton, and schema maxItems is 1.
counting_notes.witness_alternatives: mechanism_witness plus mechanism_alternatives only; field marginals accept any alternative for that field; full witness must match one entire alternative. Scalars require identical Python type as in original scorer; bool is not int, int is not float.
counting_notes.invented_vs_original_ids: INVENTED_ID means nonexistent opaque ID only. Original ids_valid and original invented_ids are copied separately because frozen scorer also flags wrong-category IDs and stops ID-slot validation after schema failure. No conflation of schema failure with an invented ID.
counting_notes.opaque_id_scan: Use original scorer all_strings traversal semantics and regex. Allowed IDs are whole-string z[0-9a-f]{16} strings anywhere in rendered JSON, including keys. Returned occurrences are word-boundary matches in JSON string keys/values; record JSON Pointer plus key/value location kind and character span. No meaning of prose is interpreted.
counting_notes.schema: Use published schema_valid and error paths, confirm parse/validation using original strict parser and jsonschema 3.2.0 with frozen schema, no schema changes.
counting_notes.code_counts: Codes overlap and must not be summed as distinct errors. Rendering count = rows bearing code. Semantic count = distinct worlds with at least one row bearing code, not >=3/4. Native representation counts separately count contrasts/worlds.
counting_notes.classification_behavior: For each gold/selected class cell report rendering count and distinct semantic cases with any such selection. A world may appear in multiple selected columns. Separately copy original semantic classification credit.
counting_notes.localization_field_counts: Report exact fields in the 24 gold-D renderings, plus semantic worlds with any exact and with all four exact. These are descriptive field counts, not localization credit.
counting_notes.evidence_counts: Missing-ID total counts one missing ID per rendering (gold set difference). Invented-ID total counts distinct bad IDs per rendering; also report globally distinct IDs and textual occurrence count.
counting_notes.pair_failure: Per cell retain both endpoints, selected and gold classes, frozen credit. Wrong selected label = classification failure. schema_valid false OR ids_valid false = validity failure. Report classification_only / validity_only / both / none per endpoint and union per failed cell. A schema-invalid original ids_valid=false is not an independently observed ID defect. Semantic failed endpoint means original semantic classification_correct=false; failed-cell contributors may include endpoints that pass semantically. Copy original pair result and correct_cells.
counting_notes.provenance: Only tracked public files at the R2 published base, plus this analysis codebook/implementation. No private paths, envelopes, native reasoning or inference APIs. Source records are public rendered cases.
counting_notes.qualitative_boundary: Do not display/read selected example prose for qualitative interpretation until deterministic outputs and hashes are committed. Numeric analysis scans prose only for the exact opaque-ID regex, without semantic interpretation.
